tema: Simple electric circuits: battery, wire, bulb, switch
objetivo: That the student understands that a bulb lights when battery, wires and bulb form a closed path, that a switch opens or closes it, that metals conduct and plastic insulates, and that wall outlets are dangerous.
hatsumon: How can we make a bulb light up?
